subject: Kickoff - DAC for learning from operator demonstrations
body:
All,

Kicking off the DAC workstream. The open-source release addresses the two things that always kill adversarial imitation learning for us: reward bias, where the learned reward implicitly rewards or punishes termination, and sample inefficiency, which it fixes by going off-policy instead of throwing away every trajectory after one update.

Our use case: we have thousands of hours of operator demonstration logs for pipeline remediation, and no reward function anyone can agree on. Imitation is the right frame, we've just never had a method that learns from a realistic number of demonstrations.

Feb 9 - Jul 20, deliberately long because the data prep is the risk:
- Mar 20: reproduce the published results with the standard expert trajectories.
- May 15: our demonstration logs converted into the same trajectory format.
- Jul 10: final imitation sweep and a recommendation.

Alina has staffing and compute. Rosa is tech lead on the data side, Carmen on method.

Dmitri
